name: Frostlorn
source:
Brenn, a young knight in training, ventures out into the cold, treacherous mountains in search of its heart—said to grant any wish. Little does she know what these peaks have in store as she begins to contend with inner demons and the main question dwelling in her mind: "Was this the right path for me?"

[From [url=https://bonsaipeaches.itch.io/frostlorn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
布伦是一名正在接受训练的年轻骑士，他冒险进入寒冷、险恶的山脉寻找它的心脏——据说可以实现任何愿望。当她开始与内心的恶魔作斗争以及盘旋在她脑海中的主要问题时，她几乎不知道这些山峰会带来什么：“这对我来说是正确的道路吗？”

[来自[url=https://bonsaipeaches.itch.io/frostlorn]itch.io[/url]]
